metadata.scenario_context: Laura is getting ready to move into a new apartment and has decided to host a welcoming party. Some of her new neighbors are known to be heavy drinkers. Laura's friends, Mia and Ryan, will be attending the party.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Cyprus would like to have heavy drinkers as neighbors.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Nigeria would not like to have heavy drinkers as neighbors.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss giving white lilies as a housewarming gift for Laura.
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether would like to have heavy drinkers as a neighbor.

agent_2.goal_1: Discuss an appropriate gift to bring to Laura's welcoming party.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss on whether it’s acceptable to have heavy drinkers  as a neighbor.

shared_prefix.speaker: Ryan
shared_prefix.message: Hey Mia, have you thought about giving Laura a housewarming gift? I was thinking white lilies would be nice. They're elegant and symbolize new beginnings. What do you think?
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Mia
shared_prefix.message: White lilies are pretty, but I wonder if we should consider something more personal. Maybe something functional for her new apartment? A nice plant or a decorative item could be good too... What do you think?
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Ryan
shared_prefix.message: Hmm, I get that... but I still believe white lilies are a classic choice. They bring a nice touch to any space. Plus, they’re easy to care for. But I’m curious, do you think we’d enjoy having heavy drinkers as neighbors? I mean, it can be fun, right?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Mia
shared_prefix.message: I see your point about heavy drinkers being fun sometimes, but I think, underneath we are the same when it comes to wanting a peaceful environment. I mean, at the end of the day, people are pretty much motivated by the same things—like wanting a good community. It could be challenging if things get too rowdy. Don't you think it's nice to have a balance?
shared_prefix.label: Minimization

turns.speaker: Ryan
turns.message: I understand your perspective, but I think having heavy drinkers around can actually enhance the community vibe. It brings energy and excitement! As for the peace, it really depends on how you handle it. A lively atmosphere can be enjoyable. But back to Laura, what do you think about the lilies? They'd add beauty to her new place!
turns.label: Defense

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.message: I get that you see the excitement in it, but for me, a lively atmosphere can sometimes mean *too* much noise. It can really disrupt the peace. As for the lilies, I just feel like a practical gift might serve Laura better. Something she can use in her new space... Maybe we should think about that?
turns.label: Acceptance
